items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: He's in the name of Chris. ... He said, oh, I'm sorry, I called him. He was calling the player. Well, I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: Once, I had a job, we had a job back at Cantillie.

A big hall, a storm, a storm place. And Tom Averitt playing violin. My husband playing clarinet. I had to play corner. I wasn't playing cornering all together yet. But a brother said, can I play that job? I said, I don't know, I'm hired myself. I wish you could play that. So I said, I tell you what I do, but I said, I'll get you in there. So I see a, oh I call this boy. I used to play corner, I did his job. Tom Abbott, Tom Abbott said, well I've been looking for corner for a while Joe. I said, well I got you one,…
I want to ask about Chris Kelly after a while too.
